name: application-segmented-control
title: Segmented Control
description: iOS-style single-select pill toggle group for switching between views or modes, with roving-tabindex keyboard navigation and a real radiogroup underneath.
useWhen: Switching between a small set of mutually exclusive views or modes (e.g. Day/Week/Month/Year).
You want a compact, button-like alternative to tabs or a select for 2-5 options.
The choice should be visually obvious at a glance without opening a menu.
avoidWhen: You have more than about five options — use a select or dropdown menu instead.
The options represent separate pages or routed content — use tabs instead.
Multiple options can be selected at once — use a toggle group instead.
responsiveBehavior: The control is an inline-flex block sized to its content; wrap it or let it scroll horizontally on narrow viewports if the option count is large.
accessibility: Rendered as role="radiogroup" with each option as role="radio" and aria-checked reflecting selection.
Keyboard support: ArrowLeft/ArrowRight (and Up/Down) move and select the adjacent option, Home/End jump to the first/last option.
Only the selected option is in the tab order (roving tabindex), matching the native radio-group interaction pattern.
Focus rings are visible via focus-visible and offset against the track background.

variants.title: Segmented control
variants.description: Four-option segmented control (Day/Week/Month/Year) with a selected pill on a light track.
accessibility: Selection state is conveyed via aria-checked, not color alone — the selected pill also has a background and shadow.

variants.title: Segmented control (Dark)
variants.description: Four-option segmented control adapted for dark surfaces, with the selected pill lifted above a darker track.
accessibility: Track, pill, and text colors must meet WCAG AA contrast on dark backgrounds.
